raw_description: 5.51 mg (NH4)6Mo7O24·4H2O and 14.27 mg thiourea were dissolved in 30 mL deionized water. Then 1 g PbTiO3 powder was added. The suspension was stirred vigorously for 30 min, sonicated for 30 min, transferred to a PTFE reactor and hydrothermally reacted. The product was washed three times with ethanol and water and vacuum dried.
notes: Hydrothermal temperature and duration are not stated in the main article.

raw_description: CTAB and SDBS were used to prepare a vesicle solution. La(NO3)3·6H2O and Ni(NO3)2·6H2O were added using the optimized La/Ni molar ratio of 2:1. NaOH was added until pH 8.5. The precipitate was filtered, washed, dried at 70 °C for 10 h, ground, and calcined at 750 °C for 5 h using a heating rate of 5 °C/min.
notes: The La/Ni = 2:1 value is a precursor molar ratio used for the optimized LaNiO3 preparation and is not treated as a modified chemical formula.

2 mmol Na2MoO4·2H2O and 0.3 g PVP (K-30) were dispersed in 80 mL deionized water and magnetically stirred for 1 h. Then 10 mmol thiourea was added slowly and the mixture was stirred for another 1 h. The solution was transferred to a 100 mL Teflon-lined autoclave and maintained at 180 °C for 36 h. The precipitate was centrifuged, washed several times with deionized water, and vacuum freeze-dried to obtain MoS2 nanospheres.
notes: Pre-synthesis of the TMD component used for the subsequent MoS2/CaTiO3 heterostructure formation.

raw_description: 10 mmol Ca(NO3)2·4H2O was dispersed in 30 mL deionized water under forceful sustained stirring for 20 min. Then 3.4 mL tetrabutyl titanate and 0.02 mol NaOH were introduced and stirred for 60 min. A certain amount of pre-synthesized MoS2 corresponding to the 0.5% sample was dispersed in the solution by ultrasonic treatment for 30 min. The mixture was treated at 200 °C for 24 h, washed, and vacuum freeze-dried.
notes: CaTiO3 is formed in the presence of pre-synthesized MoS2; therefore the route is classified as TMD-first two-stage.

raw_description: A mixture of 0.005 M sodium tungstate, 0.02 M thiourea and 0.01 M hydroxylamine hydrochloride was added to 30 mL deionized water and stirred for 30 min. Then 0.24 g CTAB was added and stirring continued for 60 min. A white precipitate with pH 6.15 was obtained. The mixture was kept in a sealed autoclave at 180 °C for 24 h. The product was washed with deionized water and ethanol and dried at 90 °C for 6 h.
notes: Separate synthesis of the WS2 component before heterostructure integration.

raw_description: Calcium nitrate and titanium diisopropoxide bis(acetylacetonate) were dissolved in an aqueous nitric-acid solution. After stirring for 30 min, tartaric acid, glucose and acrylamide were added successively. Distilled water was added to 100 mL and ammonia was added dropwise to pH 2. The solution was heated at 70 °C for 60 min, then at 120 °C for 2 h and maintained at 120 °C for 24 h until a black product was obtained. The resulting xerogel was calcined at 700 °C for 8 h.
notes: Separate synthesis of the CaTiO3 component before heterostructure integration. Multiple thermal sub-steps are preserved in raw_description; the main pre-calcination temperature/time fields represent the final 120 °C hold.

raw_description: Prepared WS2 and CaTiO3 were separately dispersed in deionized water and sonicated for 30 min. The two dispersions were mixed and stirred for 60 min. The mixture was then heated at 80 °C for 60 min under constant stirring until a thick suspension formed. The product was collected by centrifugation, washed several times with deionized water, and dried in an oven at 105 °C for at least 24 h.
notes: This record represents the intended CaTiO3(10 wt%)/WS2 sample. The paper also states a 1:1 mixing ratio in this section, which conflicts with the reported 10/20/30 wt% sample series and is therefore preserved as a source inconsistency rather than used as the normalized composition.
